title: Casefile - Videos
description:
Fact is scarier than fiction.

Established in January 2016, Casefile: True Crime Podcast presents unforgettable true crime stories in a professionally produced audio format. Presented by an anonymous host, the podcast delves into the crimes, investigations, and trials of solved and cold cases from across the world. 
https://casefilepodcast.com.

In 2019, the Casefile Presents network was launched. Casefile Presents is a space for existing podcasts to reach a wider audience while providing a platform for new podcast projects and talent to voice their stories. Silent Waves was the first podcast released on the Casefile Presents network and there a number of new and exciting podcasts planned for 2020. 
https://casefilepresents.com

We are an independently run show with no mainstream media affiliates. You can support the work of the Casefile team via Patreon: https://www.patreon.com/casefile
